title: Stand-ups through the summit (9 to 12 November): which, and when?
detail: The calendar series end today; data/meetings/schedule.json runs to 13 November. On the summit days people are on the floor at 12:00 and 18:00. A 19:00 stand-up after the doors close catches the day's leads and follow-ups while they are fresh. Once agreed, Angelo gives his go for the calendar (tier 3).
recommend: One at 19:00, after the day, with a handover note
options: One short stand-up, 08:00, before the doors open
One at 19:00, after the day, with a handover note
None: handover notes only, in commits
